name: digital-twin
description: Personal AI twin — sprint 0 landing + sprint 1 PWA shell. Static site, no framework.

scripts.e2e: cd e2e && node landing.spec.mjs && cd ../e2e && node twin-os.spec.mjs && cd ../e2e && node twin-os-songs.spec.mjs
scripts.e2e:ct: cd e2e && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" node ct-default.mjs && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" node ct-icon.mjs && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" node ct-nav.mjs && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" node ct-progress.mjs && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" node ct-theme.mjs && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" node ct-verify.mjs && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" node ct-a11y.mjs && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" node ct-phase3.mjs
scripts.e2e:clip: cd e2e && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" PORT=5180 node clip-interrogator.spec.mjs
scripts.e2e:refael: cd e2e && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" PORT=5180 node refael.spec.mjs
scripts.e2e:howto: cd e2e && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" PORT=5180 node how-to.spec.mjs
scripts.e2e:lvs: cd e2e && CHROME_PATH="${CHROME_PATH:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" PORT=5180 node loopable-video-segmenter.spec.mjs
scripts.e2e:live: cd e2e && E2E_URL=https://kajica2.github.io/digital-twin node landing.spec.mjs && cd ../e2e && E2E_URL=https://kajica2.github.io/digital-twin node twin-os.spec.mjs && cd ../e2e && E2E_URL=https://kajica2.github.io/digital-twin node twin-os-songs.spec.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:watcher && npm run test:songs-watcher && npm run test:reel-watcher && npm run test:mj && npm run test:mj-cookies && npm run test:mj-web && npm run test:mj-submitter && npm run test:mj-prompt-generator && npm run test:jazz-solos && npm run test:musicxml-pdf
scripts.clip:interrogate: uv run --project lib/clip-interrogator clip-interrogate interrogate assets/clip-interrogator/example01.jpg --mode best
